input_contract: RGB-D images plus base-frame camera 6D pose
imu_role: raw motion/stability audit; no magnetometer or absolute camera heading is inferred
pose_provenance: TF lookup at RGB timestamp; TF is produced from the installed eye-in-hand calibration and robot state
semantic_ooi_gap: verified model classes do not include fruit_stem, petiole; no fruit-stem/petiole label is inferred from another class
